status: Prepared integration instructions; no frontend implementation or acceptance claim.
scope: Implement every criterion in the unchanged full TASK012 through TASK019 baseline, using the accepted service, reader and pure client foundations.
integration_obligations: Use the raw bounded response bytes with decodeWire/decodeReadResponse before any lossy JSON parsing. Preserve exact canonical qualifier text and consuming markers.

Admit authenticated deep links atomically into query, filters, exact selection and map focus before issuing requests. The accepted pure navigate(route) function does not perform this hydration. One selection creates one coherent history entry; real Back/Forward and focus restoration remain required.

Carry the service bootstrap same-document hashchange correction into the complete app: erase private fragments before network work, preserve only safe desired routes, and prevent obsolete session/context/close/expiry callbacks from resurrecting prior state. Same-document and new-document consumed-token replay were distinct actual browser cases.

Keep one shared request/state path and renderer-independent graph model. List is the accessible primary graph representation. Complete-prefix budget handling uses the pre-request retry cursor when a suffix cannot be retained; never silently consume the suffix.

Preserve exact original source reference identities and canonical locator semantics. Process views come only from validated explicit mappings and evidence, never type/name or arbitrary edge ordering inference.

Use text-safe DOM construction for canonical content, the strict production CSP, no remote resources, no privileged authoring UI, and readable empty/loading/stale/refused/disconnected states. Do not replace missing evidence with invented totals or sequence.

Read BUILD.md and use the exact pinned toolchain, lock, notices and manifest-last publisher. The accepted pure foundation files and Python service remain separate-owner inputs; return a concrete defect to the manager rather than editing them outside the baseline write scope.

runtime_test_protocol.ownership: Frontend worker owns only its scoped source/tests/evidence. Primary host may execute reviewed frozen disposable service/browser test drivers and return exact stdout/stderr/exit receipts; manager owns canonical acceptance.
runtime_test_protocol.prepare: Freeze complete current test inputs in a uniquely named private temporary stage, hash each regular single-link relative file and the runner, declare exact command, lifetime, intended temporary writes and cleanup. Keep that stage unchanged through execution. Use the existing installed Playwright and bundled Node runtime when appropriate; no new test dependency is implied.
runtime_test_protocol.secrets: Bootstrap URL and credentials stay in process memory or the exact private runtime file. No traces, HAR, raw navigation errors, credentials in command arguments or screenshots before positive fragment removal. Report fixed safe checkpoints and status/count diagnostics.
runtime_test_protocol.attribution: Record the actual host executor and exact receipt. A direct Playwright goto is not proof of OS default-browser dispatch. Instrumented DOM tests are not real browser or assistive-technology evidence.
runtime_test_protocol.cleanup: Stop/reap only exact owned processes, close only test-created browser contexts/tabs, verify unchanged input fixtures, and preserve all failed receipts. No broad kill or unrelated profile/settings changes.

shared_live_outputs: Frontend legitimately revises main.ts, index.html and runtime assets delivered by SERVICE_PACKAGE. Those live changes invalidate affected prior service verification.

After frontend writes settle and its owner is stopped, the manager must rebind the same service owner to final current assets and obtain current service/package verification. Then revise the unchanged full FRONTEND baseline through the supported helper version gate, refresh stale same-path input references, and rebind/reverify the frontend result against the new service dependency version.
Historical immutable artifacts remain evidence of their exact earlier versions. They cannot substitute for verification of later edits to shared live files.
later_gates: TASK020 through TASK033 remain required: production safety/offline, actual accessibility, full preservation/performance, real participant walkthrough, Template and root adoption, qualified workbench cutover/rollback, release material and final bidirectional verification. Full frontend delivery is not final project completion.
